name: Race Track Mayhem
description: A toy-car racing game for kids. Pick a toy car and race around seven tracks set up in giant rooms of the house (the bedroom, playroom, kitchen, bathroom, living room and garage) and out in the garden, plus a new Weekly Challenge track every Monday. Loop-de-loops, corkscrews, spiral climbs, big jumps, power-ups and a Ready, Set, GO! countdown. Build and share your own tracks, race friends online with a race code, chase online best times, and unlock paint jobs and secret cars. Keyboard, controller or touch screen.
requirements: Graphics that support OpenGL 3.3 (almost any PC from the last 10 years)
Keyboard, or an Xbox-style game controller
On Android: Android 5.0 or newer, played with the touch screen
